backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a shipping container manufacturing tracker with user profiles, production records, dispatch records, daily production reports, and role-based access control (admin/viewer) using Internet Identity authentication.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four features for the DailyProductionReportForm and ContainerDailyReportPage components: auto-calculating Total Completed from historical data, computing In Hand as Total Completed minus Despatch, adding batch dispatch entry, and displaying calculated values in the report page.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend components, pages, and hooks describing their functionality including routing, authentication, role-based access control, production tracking forms, and data display tables.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining light and dark theme color schemes using OKLCH color space for the application's design system.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with viewport meta tag and title 'Shipping Container Manufacturing Production Tracker'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for dashboard, production entry/history, dispatch tracking, work-in-hand, daily reports, and container reports, all wrapped with AuthGuard, Layout, ThemeProvider, and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Component displaying an access denied message with shield icon and login button for unauthenticated users attempting to access protected routes.
frontend/src/components/AuthGuard.tsx: Authentication guard component that checks login status, enforces role-based route access (redirecting viewers to production dashboard for restricted routes), shows loading states, displays access denied screen for unauthenticated users, and triggers profile setup modal for new users.
frontend/src/components/DailyProductionR: Filter component for daily production reports with date range (start/end) and operation selection, providing apply and clear functionality.

Form component for creating and editing daily production reports with fields for date, operation, production quantities, and dispatch; includes automatic calculations for total completed and in-hand inventory.
Sortable table component displaying daily production reports with columns for date, operation, production metrics, and an edit action; supports multi-column sorting with visual indicators.
Reusable date range filter component with start/end date inputs and apply/clear actions, enforcing logical date constraints.
frontend/src/components/DispatchEntryFor: Form component for recording dispatch entries with fields for date, container type, quantity, destination, and tracking reference; includes role-based access control.
frontend/src/components/DispatchRecordsT: Sortable table component displaying dispatch records with columns for date, container type, quantity, destination, and tracking reference.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with sticky header, navigation menu (filtered by user role), mobile menu toggle, and authentication-aware routing using TanStack Router.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/OperationCompari: Bar chart component displaying total completed production grouped and sorted by operation name using Recharts.
frontend/src/components/ProductionDashbo: Table component showing production details including operation name, today's production, total completed, dispatched, and in-hand quantities.
frontend/src/components/ProductionHistor: Sortable table component for production records with columns for date, container type, quantity, shift, and notes, supporting multi-field sorting.
frontend/src/components/ProductionTrendC: Line chart component visualizing daily total production output over time, aggregating reports by date using Recharts.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for first-time user profile setup, prompting for name input with form submission to save caller user profile.
frontend/src/components/RecentProduction: Table component displaying a limited number of recent production records with date, container type, quantity, shift, and notes.
frontend/src/components/SummaryCard.tsx: Reusable card component displaying a title, numeric value, icon, and optional description with hover effects.
React component that displays a table of work-in-hand inventory records showing container types, produced quantities, dispatched quantities, and current inventory with a card layout.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that manages the backend actor instance with authentication, initializes access control with admin token from URL params, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
Custom mutation hook for adding dispatch records that invalidates dispatch and work-in-hand status queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddProductionRecor: Custom mutation hook for adding production records that invalidates production and work-in-hand status queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateDailyProduct: Custom mutation hook for creating daily production reports with date, operation ID, production, dispatch, and in-hand quantities that invalidates daily production reports on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllDailyProduct: Custom query hook that fetches all daily production reports with auto-refresh every 30 seconds.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllDispatchReco: Custom query hook that fetches all dispatch records from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllOperations.t: Custom query hook that fetches all operations from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllProductionRe: Custom query hook that fetches all production records from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerRole.ts: Custom query hook that fetches the current caller's role from the backend with combined loading state from actor and query.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: Custom query hook that fetches the current caller's user profile from the backend with combined loading state from actor and query.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetProductionRecor: Custom query hook that fetches production records filtered by date range, falling back to all records if no dates provided.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetWorkInHandStatu: Custom query hook that fetches work-in-hand status records from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity state, and auth client creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: Custom query hook that checks if the current caller has admin privileges.
frontend/src/hooks/useMonthlyProductionM: Custom hook that calculates monthly production metrics including total produced, remaining to target (100), completion percentage, and daily average from daily production reports.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Consolidated file containing multiple query and mutation hooks for user profiles, production records, dispatch records, and work-in-hand status (appears to duplicate functionality from individual hook files).
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: Custom mutation hook for saving the caller's user profile name that invalidates the current user profile query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateDailyProduct: Custom mutation hook for updating daily production reports by finding the report ID from date and operation, then updating production, dispatch, and in-hand quantities.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom industrial-themed color palette for light and dark modes, including CSS variables for UI components and utility classes for tables, cards, and Excel-style layouts.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, rendering the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/ContainerDailyReportP: Displays a date-filtered Excel-style table showing daily production metrics (today's production, total completed, dispatched, in-hand) for all 17 operations, merging operation data with daily reports.
frontend/src/pages/DailyProductionReport: Manages daily production reports with filtering by date range and operation, displaying a form for creating/editing reports (hidden for viewers) and a table of filtered results.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Main dashboard showing production overview with summary cards for total produced, container types, dispatched, and work-in-hand metrics, plus a table of recent production records.
Dispatch tracking page with a form for recording new dispatches (hidden for viewers) and a table displaying all dispatch records sorted by date.
frontend/src/pages/ProductionDashboardPa: Live production dashboard with auto-refresh showing monthly metrics (total produced, target progress, completion percentage), summary cards, production trend charts, and operation comparison visualizations.
frontend/src/pages/ProductionEntryPage.t: Form page for entering new production records with fields for date, container type, quantity, shift, and notes, with role-based access control showing read-only message for viewers.
frontend/src/pages/ProductionHistoryPage: Production history page that displays filterable daily production reports in a table, with edit functionality for non-viewer roles and a form for editing reports.
frontend/src/pages/WorkInHandPage.tsx: Work in hand status page showing current inventory by container type with summary cards for total inventory, produced, dispatched quantities, and active operations.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters and session storage, supporting both regular query strings and hash-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended theme settings for industrial UI, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state document describing a responsive industrial production tracking web app for 40ft High Cube Container manufacturing with role-based access control, 17 predefined operations, and mobile-first design.
